title: Project Sync & Q3 Budget Prep
agenda: Status of the new onboard flow
discussion_points: The wireframes for the new onboard flow are finished but require a round of revisions for the mobile layout, which will take 3-4 days.
Backend development for the onboard flow can start in parallel by setting up API endpoints and extending the existing database schema.
A proposal was made to build an AI meeting intelligence agent to automate the generation of structured minutes and push action items to a planner.
The Q3 budget review is scheduled for next Monday, and all department estimates are due by this Friday.
decisions: Sarah's team will revise the onboard flow wireframes before handing them to the developers.
Anas's team will begin backend development for the onboard flow in parallel.
A proof of concept for an AI meeting intelligence agent will be developed as a high-priority project.
All department budget estimates must be submitted by Friday.

action_items.task: Revise the onboard flow wireframes and get them to the developers.
Start backend work for the new onboard flow by setting up API endpoints.
Develop a proof of concept for the AI meeting intelligence agent.
Provision Azure resources (speech API) for the AI agent project.
Give Omar access to the SharePoint templates library.
Submit department budget estimates for Q3.

follow_ups: The Q3 budget review meeting is scheduled for next Monday, 2026-05-25.
